title: Tim Cook’s Apple: his 10 biggest wins and misses
summary: Tim Cook is stepping down after 15 years as Apple CEO, succeeded by hardware leader John Ternus, marking the end of an era that saw significant products and services launches alongside notable setbacks.
content:
Expectations for Tim Cook were almost impossibly high when he stepped in to replace Apple's visionary co-founder in 2011. He inherited a company on a blockbuster run, after Steve Jobs returned and revitalized the Mac, launched the iPod, and oversaw the launch of the iPhone.
Now, after 15 years in the CEO role, Tim Cook is stepping down. He's replaced today by hardware leader John Ternus. Over the course of Cook's tenure, Apple accomplished a lot, with the launch of plenty of new products, features, and services that the company just wouldn't be the same without. title: TP-Link’s first Wi-Fi 8 router is almost here
summary: TP-Link unveiled the Archer 8 Ultra router and Deco 8 Ultra mesh system using the Wi-Fi 8 standard, prioritizing practical connectivity improvements over raw speed increases.
content:
Here you can see the Archer 8 Ultra (bottom) and the Deco 8 Ultra (top). | Image: TP-Link	

The Wi-Fi 8 standard is far from finalized, but TP-Link is almost ready to release its first hardware targeting the next-gen spec. It unveiled the Archer 8 Ultra tri-band router and Deco 8 Ultra mesh system at IFA 2026, which utilize the upcoming IEEE 802.11bn standard to "address the connectivity problems people actually notice" instead of focusing on speed upgrades, according to TP-Link's announcement.

title: John Ternus is now the CEO of Apple
summary: John Ternus becomes Apple's new CEO, replacing Tim Cook who remains executive chairman, as the company navigates AI adoption and component shortages.
content:
Apple SVP John Ternus takes over as CEO from Tim Cook. | AFP via Getty Images	

For the first time since 2011, one of the world's most valuable companies has a new leader, as today marks John Ternus' first day as Apple's CEO. He's replacing Tim Cook, who will continue on as the executive chairman on Apple's board and departed with a letter to employees that remarked, "This place is proof that culture triumphs over everything. We share a belief that what we build matters, and that we have both the opportunity and the responsibility to leave the world better than we found it."

title: If space data centers feel far-fetched, why not interstellar travel?
summary: Starcloud, the team behind orbital data centers, is now pursuing an ambitious new venture: sending a probe to Alpha Centauri.
content: The team behind Starcloud's orbital data centers has a new high-risk space project: Sending a probe to Alpha Centauri.

title: Dyson made a camera-equipped toothbrush that flosses for you
summary: Dyson launched the CameraJet, a $499 electric toothbrush with an integrated camera and AI-powered automated flossing that streams footage to your phone.
content:
Dyson is expanding into oral care with its first toothbrush featuring a camera and flossing capabilities. | Image: Dyson	

Dyson is once again expanding its line of personal care products with a device that focuses on your teeth instead of your hair. As the name implies, the $499 CameraJet is the first electric toothbrush to incorporate a camera into the brush head. Available starting today in ceramic blue or ceramic pink color options, it can let you inspect the inside of your mouth by livestreaming video over Wi-Fi to your phone. But the camera also works alongside an AI algorithm to detect and blast the gaps between your teeth with mouthwash. So while you're brushing, the CameraJet simultaneously takes care of flossing.

title: Magna increases bet on battery swapping in India with $35M for Yuma

content: Magna's investment in Yuma Energy has reached $87 million as the Canadian auto supplier increases its majority stake in the Indian battery-swapping firm.

title: Lachy Groom backs Indian startup aiming to keep aircraft aloft for a year
summary: Alteon, a startup founded by a 20-year-old, is developing autonomous aircraft designed to harvest wind energy to stay aloft for extended periods, backed by venture capitalist Lachy Groom. The technology aims to potentially keep aircraft operational for months, representing a significant advancement in long-duration aerial systems.
content: Founded by a 20-year-old, Alteon is developing autonomous aircraft that hopes to harvest wind energy to stay aloft for several months.

zh.title: Lachy Groom支持印度初创企业开发能在空中持续飞行一年的飞机
zh.summary: 由20岁创始人创办的初创公司Alteon正在开发自主无人机，通过收集风能实现长时间空中飞行，获得风险投资家Lachy Groom的支持。该技术可能使飞机持续运行数个月，代表了长续航航空系统的重大进展。

title: Apple shares ‘shocking evidence’ against former employee accused of stealing company data for OpenAI
summary: Apple has presented evidence against a former employee accused of stealing confidential company data for OpenAI, alleging the employee destroyed evidence after learning of the investigation. The case highlights concerns about corporate espionage and data security in the competitive AI industry.
content: Apple says it has evidence that a former employee destroyed evidence of data theft after learning he was under investigation.

zh.title: 苹果公开"令人震惊的证据"控告前员工为OpenAI窃取公司数据
zh.summary: 苹果提交了针对被指控为OpenAI窃取机密公司数据的前员工的证据，并指控该员工在得知调查后销毁了证据。该案件凸显了在激烈竞争的人工智能行业中对企业间谍活动和数据安全的担忧。
